description: Retrieve one stored compliance evaluation by id — the audit record compliance_evaluate wrote. Only the caller who ran it can read it; another account's id answers "not found" exactly like an unknown one. Paid plans only; requires the compliance:read scope. Returns the decision, the stored result (per-check outcomes, missing inputs, remediation, policy version and hash), the evidence references and the input hash.
name: compliance_evaluation
title: compliance_evaluation
